review.title: KZ consortium: complete Arthrobacter genus-reference alternatives
review.independence_basis: The source preparation was independently read against the whole current KZ record, retained primary abstract, native routes and historical batch60 caller. The parent separately reviewed both local and actual M5 candidates and all30 actual stage input hashes before application. This assessment is limited to database correspondence, exact persistence and scoped native validation.
review.summary: The existing genus-level Arthrobacter descriptor now records AMBIGUOUS with all eleven ordered native alternatives. No alternative is assigned to SZ-3. Both source stocks, the existing Klebsiella block, all biological claims and old history remain unchanged. The actual M5 application, one native inline event, one separate native sidecar and eight scoped passed commands are bound to this partial diagnostic.
review.scope_description: One selected taxonomy descriptor's status and complete genus-reference alternatives, the source-stock and population limits, exact guarded persistence, append-only history and eight actual native checks. This does not reapprove scientific claims or resolve unread source corrections.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000344 is the single end-to-end canary for the four-record intake344/498/369/405. The other three records remain unapplied until the saved pair, complete input checkpoint and strict historical successor are verified.
limitations: Partial diagnostic with scientific_review:false. These scoped validators do not establish whole-record scientific completion, full corpus QC, reference-snippet coverage, product regeneration or completion of the broader campaign.

Source examination covers the complete retained PubMed abstract. No new full original Methods, figures, supplementary material or corrigendum body was read. PMID41456976 / doi:10.1016/j.biortech.2025.133853 remains unresolved under issue1541; the captured issue snapshot records its observed OPEN state, not a later-state guarantee.

The source names Klebsiella sp. CW-D3T and Arthrobacter sp. SZ-3. Both genus-level stock identities remain unchanged. None of the eleven genus-reference alternatives establishes SZ-3 species identity, an exact stock genome, a candidate probability or a formal rename.

The selected native ncbi_rank_g population supplies the full ordered alternative set. No candidate is chosen and no ambiguity-route genome denominator is invented. The existing Klebsiella block, including its original support44527 and total44529, is preserved rather than replaced from a newer lookup.

The exact761d5537 crosswalk hash establishes retained bytes, not the upstream release. Neither file mtime nor an NCBI database size/mtime observation establishes a release or complete database content digest. The local and M5 NCBI observations are retained separately.

The one COMMUNITY_LEVEL node, both participants, PARTIAL assay-based division of labor, positive monoculture comparison and absence of directed causal arrows remain unchanged. The25mg/L cadmium condition and distinctions between degradation, mineralization and inferred catabolic roles remain. Metagenomic gene content does not independently establish expression or necessary mediation.

Exact co-contamination medium, inoculation ratio and phenanthrene dose remain unresolved. Existing open record discussions and the historical needs_research disposition remain; this mapping/status correction does not supply the missing cultivation or causal evidence.

The native log reports two taxa processed, but only one descriptor changed and one actual GTDB_SET_STATUS event was appended. All unselected taxonomy, source quotes, biological fields and earlier history remain intact.

Source reporting was prepared locally at320b21d5 with Python3.13.12; actual M5 staging, application and all eight scoped commands ran at8ad0cacc with Python3.13.2. These are distinct retained execution observations, not a clean aggregate QC claim.

Strict batch60 admission is subsequent integration work. It must preserve the immutable ledger, historical predecessor event, every current biological predicate and both other records KMC and Komagataella/Ecoli. No historical caller was changed before this saved-input checkpoint.

assessments.topic: Source stock identity and abstract-only boundary
assessments.summary: Retain the two source stocks and genus-rank SZ-3 descriptor without inventing a species, assembly or alias. The retained abstract supports the KZ pairing and bounded assay context; unread correction/Methods and scientific uncertainties remain unresolved.

The persisted selected descriptor records AMBIGUOUS with all eleven ordered native alternatives. No genus/species cluster is chosen for SZ-3; no stock probability, ambiguity denominator or crosswalk release is inferred. The existing Klebsiella block is unchanged.
